P_calibration.quote: Criminal liability under 5(b) for conduct that becomes prohibited only by an undefined Secretary's "comparable risk" determination will be difficult to sustain; a defendant who relied on a reasonable reading of the definition has a strong argument against willfulness.
P_calibration.note: Also item 8 says the rule of lenity would push courts to read (B) narrowly.
